item.title: Russia’s LNG exports fall 2% in January-November, data shows
item.description: Russia’s exports of liquefied natural gas fell by 2% in January-November to 28.4 million metric tons, LSEG data showed on Monday. For November alone, Russian LNG shipments increased by 10% to 3.19 million tons from a year earlier, while slipping by 4.5% from October, when supplies reached a monthly record high.
